findings.observation: In the transaction log, 3 payments take funds from 8060BA880 through 2 other accounts and back to it within 6.92 days: 8060BA880 to 8060A62F0 68,647.24; 8060A62F0 to 8060AF460 100,578.47; 8060AF460 to 8060BA880 196,999.50.
